expressions.cn: 你能帮我吗？ (Nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma?)
你能再说一遍吗？ (Nǐ néng zài shuō yī biàn ma?)
你有空吗？(Nǐ yǒu kòng ma?)

work.scenario: You're in a team meeting discussing a new project. You need clarification on a task and want to confirm your understanding. You also need to ask a colleague for help with a specific detail.

life.scenario: You're at a local market and need assistance from a vendor. Later, you bump into a friend and want to check their availability for a meet-up this weekend.

tech.scenario: You're troubleshooting a software issue and need to contact technical support. You then arrange an online collaboration session with a team member and need to confirm their availability.
